text:
Augustus III bought Correggio's *Adoration of the Shepherds*, known as *La Notte* (The Night), in 1746, and it now hangs in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden. I'm not fully certain of this: *Jupiter and Io* is also linked to the Dresden collection and the Modena holdings, so the two may be easy to confuse.

CONFIDENCE: 75
